MINUTES OF MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN VENTURE ONE (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON 2 3 RD DAY OF FEBRUARY 2021 
 
 Agenda 
 
 ADVANCEMENT OF LOAN TO ZAMEEN SIGMA (RIVATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to advance a loan in the principal amount of Rs. 25 , 1 00,000 (Rupees twenty-five million one hundred thousan d ) to Zameen Sigma (Private) Limited (“ Borrower ”). 
 
 The Board unanimously nominated Imran Ali Khan t o discuss, negotiate, and accept this proposal. 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved by the Board that the Company advance a loan in the principal amount of Rs. 25 , 1 00,000 (Rupees twenty-five million one hundred thousan d ) to the Borrower. 
 
 Resolved further by the Board that Imran Ali Khan is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction.

 Company Secretary
